To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the structural analysis of protein complexes can be used to predict protein interactions.

1) the structural information can be used to determine the interaction between two proteins and to predict the binding energy of the complex, 2) protein complexes can be analyzed in terms of their compatibility with other complexes and the compatibility analysis can be used to predict new complexes, 3) protein complexes can also be analyzed in terms the effect of mutations and 4) the structural information is important for understanding the dynamics of protein complexes and for determining the equilibrium and kinetic parameters

1) the combination of experimental methods, computational tools, and structural information is crucial to understanding and analyzing protein interaction networks; 2) structural information can be used to determine protein-protein interaction sites, and to predict new interactions and interaction partners; 3) structural information can help to understand the effect of mutations on protein-protein interactions, and 4) structural information can also be used to estimate the equilibrium and kinetic parameters of protein interaction networks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the integration of structural information with other sources of data in the context of a biological network.
the use of computational tools to analyze, predict and model protein interaction networks.
the analysis of protein-protein interaction networks using structural and computational tools.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
structural information is an invaluable tool to analyze and predict protein interaction networks.
the combination of structural and computational methods will be crucial to understand protein interaction networks and the changes in these networks in the future.
the use of structural methods to predict and analyze protein interactions is a very valuable tool that will continue to be of importance in the future.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of structural and bioinformatics tools is very promising for the determination of protein interaction networks.
structural information, when combined with computational methods and biological validation, is an important step in the analysis of protein interaction networks.
the combination of structural information and computational tools can be a valuable tool in the determination and analysis of protein interaction networks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a large number of protein interactions are predicted from structural information, and that these interactions are compatible with the known structure.
a combination of experimental and structural information allows us to obtain valuable information about protein interaction networks and their changes in space and time.
a combination of structural and computational tools can provide a powerful framework to predict, understand and model protein interactions.
